intended_purpose: A non-invasive, reusable elastic ankle brace intended to provide external compression and mechanical support to the ankle joint during recovery from minor sprains, for over-the-counter use without a prescription.
device_description: Knitted elastic fabric brace with a removable stabilizing strap, non-sterile, reusable, washable, single size range (S-XL by fit chart). Class I device under EU MDR Annex VIII Rule 1 (non-invasive device). No electronic components, no measuring function.
clinical_data_summary: Small usability study (n=5) assessed comfort, correct self-application, and skin tolerance over a 2-week home-use period; no clinical efficacy trial was required or performed, consistent with a Class I device relying on general safety and performance requirements rather than pivotal clinical evidence.
risk_summary: Risk management file per ISO 14971 identifies 9 hazards, primarily skin irritation, incorrect self-fitting, and fabric degradation with repeated washing. All residual risks rated acceptable after mitigation (hypoallergenic materials, clear fitting diagram in the IFU, wash-cycle guidance).

clinical_trial_data.trial_name: Usability study, n=5 (home-use comfort and self-application)
